#comment: THE DESIGN INTENT. Every combat number in media/tng_ships.json is generated from
this file by _tools/retune_ships.py, so a balance change is a small reviewable
diff here rather than a 140 KB diff in the ship data.
CLASS FIRST, CANON SECOND. A hull's weight class fixes the band it sits in; canon
only decides WHERE inside that band. That is the rule that stops a Defiant
out-tanking a Galaxy - but it is NOT a rule that makes the Defiant weak. It is a
171 m ship, so it is medium; being famously over-engineered for its size is then
expressed as the CEILING of the medium band in shields, hull and guns at once,
plus the sharpest turn rate in the class. It beats every other medium at
everything and out-guns the softest heavies. What it cannot do is out-tank a
Galaxy, which is the canon too.
SHIELD bands do not overlap - that is what makes a class mean something, and it is
checked. GUN bands are allowed to touch, deliberately: a glass-cannon medium
out-shooting a tanky heavy is the point of having both.
The band anchors come from data/shipData.yaml, not from taste: tsn_light_cruiser
(120 shields, hull 3, guns 0.33) anchors light; tsn_battleship (200, 5, 0.73) and
tsn_dreadnought (220, 8, 0.83) anchor heavy; tsn_juggernaut (400, 9) anchors
capital. That shared curve is what lets stock and TNG hulls fight on one map.
`guns` is coef_sum = sum(damage_coeff / cycle_time). Real DPS is coef_sum x the
set_beam_damages base, which LegendaryMissions sets to 7.0 for players and
DIFFICULTY/2+3 for NPCs. coef_sum is the half a ship's own data owns.
#faction_comment: Each faction fires a recognisably different weapon, expressed only in numbers the
format already has. `arc` is the beam's total arcwidth in degrees; `cycle_bias`
shifts that faction inside its class's cycle band (below 1.0 = faster guns, and
because `guns` is held fixed, faster also means each individual shot lands softer).
Federation get the WIDEST arcs in the game - phaser strips wrap the hull - and the
mod currently gives Starfleet the narrowest arcs of anyone, at 90 degrees. Klingons
get the narrowest arcs and the fastest cycle: turn to face a Klingon or lose. Today
they have the narrow arcs AND the slowest guns in the mod (the Negh'Var cycles at
18.83 s), which is all of the downside and none of the payoff.
#ships_comment: front  = forward shield points. Rear is derived from rear_ratio above. Stations
have a single facing.
hull   = hullpoints. For SHIPS this is a size tier, 1-9, NOT hit points - the mod
currently runs 12-25 on some hulls, which is out of band and only inflates
derived system-node pools. For STATIONS it really is armor.
guns   = coef_sum target. Every beam's damage_coeff is scaled by ONE shared factor
to hit this exactly, so each ship keeps the shape of its own battery -
which of its guns are the big ones and which are point defence.
tubes  = torpedo tubes, with `torps` naming the type and magazine. TORPEDOES ARE
PLAYER-ONLY - NPCs never launch one (cosmos_dev/mock/sbs.py says so, and
stock gives every NPC tubecount 0). Five of the seven factions had 0
tubes on every hull, so a mission could not seat a crew in a Romulan or
Cardassian ship and have them fire anything. This opens that door and
changes no fight the player did not choose.
drone  = drone_launch_timer, seconds between launches. THIS is the NPC-facing
projectile: the field's mere presence sets elite_drone_launcher=1 and the
engine fires drones for that hull, at 15 damage out to 7000 units. So a
faction's identity in a fight is beams AND drones, not beams alone.
Currently only the five Romulan entries carry it, and only because they
re-skinned the Torgoth hulls, which had it. Assigned deliberately here:
Romulans standoff, the Dominion swarms, the Breen lob slowly. Klingons
get none - they close and knife-fight, which is what the fast narrow
beams above are for - and the carrier factions use `baycount` instead.
turn   = optional turn_rate override. Handling is NOT class-banded, deliberately -
it is the one lever that can make a ship feel special without moving it
out of its weight class. For a PLAYER hull it is also the only handling
stat that matters, because player top speed is hull-independent and
speed_coeff applies to NPCs only.

tng_fed_galaxy.note: the baseline heavy; every other ship is read against it

tng_fed_galaxy_x.note: 1.6x a Galaxy, not the 2.9x it is today

tng_fed_sovereign.note: top of heavy, not a class of its own

tng_fed_ambassador.note: bottom of heavy - an older ship

tng_fed_nebula.note: torpedo boat: modest beams, biggest magazine in the fleet

tng_fed_excelsior_refit.note: a refit of an old design; floor of the class

tng_fed_defiant.note: THE fan ship, and built to feel like it: the ceiling of the medium band in shields, hull AND guns, plus the best turn rate in the class. It out-fights every medium, out-turns everything, and out-guns the weakest heavies at 0.95 against their 0.90 floor - it only loses a straight slugging match to a Galaxy, which is the canon. Ablative armour and an over-engineered shield grid on a 171 m hull is exactly what the ship is.

tng_fed_saber.note: a frigate, back below every medium

tng_fed_california.note: long but lightly armed - length is not the class

tng_fed_nova.note: science vessel; currently tankier than a Galaxy

tng_fed_ds9.note: the Starfleet refit: tougher and better armed than Terok Nor

tng_klg_vorcha.note: currently out-shot by a T'Varo scout

tng_rmn_scimitar.note: the mod's designated leader hull; at or above the Galaxy-X

tng_rmn_tvaro.note: had no weight class at all; was out-gunning a Vor'Cha

tng_crd_keldon.note: was unclassed; a major refit of the Galor

tng_crd_terok_nor.note: currently more fragile than a Bird-of-Prey

tng_jem_attack_ship.note: 68 m, reclassed down from medium - a gun out of all proportion to its size

tng_kaz_carrier.note: hullpoints was 25, the highest in the mod, on a 250 m raider

tng_kaz_base.note: 3000 shields today - a stock value stranded in a 10x roster
